'''Red 1''' was a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was flown by [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], and had previously been stationed at [[Dantooine base/Legends|Dantooine base]] prior to being transferred to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="CCG-Red1" /> [[R5-K6/Legends|R5-K6]] served as Red 1's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="Guardians">{{SW|url=news/yavin-4-rebels-guardians-of-the-hidden-fortress|text=Yavin 4 Rebels: Guardians of the Hidden Fortress|nolive=1}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Red 1 was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] after Dreis launched an unsuccessful attempt to launch [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] attempted to cover for Dreis as he pulled out of the trench and attempted to evade the Dark Lord, but Dreis ordered Skywalker to prepare for his attack run. Red 1 was destroyed shortly after.<ref name="ANH" />
